title: Compare what we said with what we did
statement: As a developer, I can see a Plan side by side with the Review or Reviews that implement it, so I can judge how what we did differs from what we said we would do.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Plan can name more than one Review that implements it, and each of those Reviews links back to the Plan.
The comparison shows the planned work beside what the Reviews delivered, identifying planned work that no Review delivered and delivered work the Plan did not include.
